{{Quote|Fighting alone, he stopped all seven of the murderers, saving the life of the Prince of Lannik as well as those of the Corellian emissaries&mdash;my own father and mother.|Adi Gallia on Even Piell|<ref name="Star Wars (1998) 13" />}}
This [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] was the '''father''' of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Adi Gallia/Legends|Adi Gallia]]. He and his [[Adi Gallia's mother|wife]] were both [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] and served as [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomats]].<ref name="Star Wars (1998) 13" />

Sometime before [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], Gallia's parents were on a diplomatic mission to the planet [[Lannik/Legends|Lannik]] when members of [[Red Iaro/Legends|Red Iaro]], a terrorist group, launched a suicide mission against the [[Lannik High Court]]. [[Even Piell/Legends|Even Piell]], the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] assigned to watch the proceedings, managed to defeat all of them at the cost of his left [[Eye/Legends|eye]].<ref name="Star Wars (1998) 13" />
